controller.heading: 1. Who is responsible for your data?
controller.intro: We care about protecting your privacy. This policy explains what data we collect via [URL_DU_SITE], why, for how long, and what rights you can exercise.

scope.heading: 2. Scope
scope.paragraph: This policy covers the processing carried out as part of the [URL_DU_SITE] site and the services offered there. It does not apply to third-party sites we may link to, which have their own rules.

dataCollected.heading: 3. What data do we collect?
dataCollected.contactForm: Via the contact form: [CHAMPS_DU_FORMULAIRE — e.g. name, surname, email address, phone number, message content]
dataCollected.technicalLogs: Connection data and technical logs: IP address, date and time of the request, pages viewed, browser and operating system type, referring site
dataCollected.cookiesNote: Data from cookies and trackers, according to your consent preferences (see point 10)
dataCollected.noSensitiveData: We do not collect sensitive data (health, political opinions, religious beliefs, sexual orientation, biometric data) and invite you not to share any via our forms.
dataCollected.sensitiveDataNote: (To be adapted if the activity necessarily involves it — e.g. medical or non-profit sector.)

legalBasis.heading: 4. Why and on what legal basis?

contactForm.purpose: Responding to your requests via the contact form
contactForm.basis: Legitimate interest (art. 6.1.f) — responding to requests received

contract.purpose: Managing the pre-contractual and contractual relationship
contract.basis: Performance of a contract or pre-contractual measures (art. 6.1.b)

security.purpose: Ensuring the security and proper functioning of the site

analytics.purpose: Measuring audience and improving the site

legalObligation.purpose: Complying with our legal obligations (accounting, tax)

legalBasis.consentNote: Where processing is based on your consent, you may withdraw it at any time, without affecting the lawfulness of processing already carried out.
legalBasis.legitimateInterestNote: Where it is based on our legitimate interest, we have weighed that interest against your rights; you may object to it at any time on grounds relating to your particular situation.

processors.heading: 5. Who has access to your data?
processors.intro: Your data is processed by authorized staff of [DÉNOMINATION_SOCIALE] and, where applicable, by providers acting as processors on our behalf, bound by a contract compliant with Article 28 of the GDPR:
processors.outro: We do not sell your data and do not share it with third parties for direct marketing purposes. It may be disclosed to the competent authorities where required by law.

transfers.heading: 6. Does your data leave the European Union?
transfers.paragraph: Some of our providers are established or store data outside the European Economic Area (United States (hosting), Switzerland (database)). These transfers are governed by [MÉCANISME — European Commission adequacy decision / standard contractual clauses], supplemented where appropriate by additional measures. You can obtain a copy by writing to [EMAIL_PRIVACY].

retention.heading: 7. How long do we keep your data?
retention.paragraph: Retention periods are listed in the table in point 4. Beyond that, data is deleted or irreversibly anonymized. Some data may be kept longer in archived form where a legal obligation or the defense of a legal claim justifies it.

security.heading: 8. How do we protect your data?
security.paragraph: We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures: encryption of communications (HTTPS/TLS), access restricted to authorized personnel, strong passwords, regular updates, backups[AUTRES_MESURES]. As no system is infallible, we cannot guarantee absolute security, but we commit to notifying any data breach under the conditions set out by the GDPR.

rights.heading: 9. What are your rights?
rights.intro: In accordance with Articles 15 to 22 of the GDPR, you have the following rights:
rights.access: Access — obtain confirmation that your data is being processed and receive a copy of it
rights.rectification: Rectification — have inaccurate or incomplete data corrected
rights.erasure: Erasure — request the deletion of your data, in the cases provided for by law
rights.restriction: Restriction — request the temporary freezing of a disputed processing operation
rights.objection: Objection — object to processing based on our legitimate interest, and at any time and without justification to direct marketing
rights.portability: Portability — receive, in a structured format, the data you provided us, for processing based on consent or a contract
rights.withdrawConsent: Withdrawal of consent — at any time, for processing that depends on it
rights.automatedDecision: Automated decision-making — not be subject to a decision based solely on automated processing producing legal effects (we do not practice this — to be adapted if that is not the case)
rights.exercise: To exercise these rights, write to [EMAIL_PRIVACY] or to the postal address indicated in point 1. We may request proof of identity in case of reasonable doubt. We respond within one month, extendable by two months for complex requests.
rights.complaintAuthority: Complaint: if you believe your rights are not being respected, you may lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority: Rue de la Presse 35, 1000 Brussels — +32 (0)2 274 48 00 — contact@apd-gba.be — www.autoriteprotectiondonnees.be

cookies.paragraph: The use of cookies and trackers is detailed in our <link>Cookie Policy</link>. You can change or withdraw your preferences at any time via [MOYEN_DE_RETRAIT_DU_CONSENTEMENT].

minors.heading: 11. Minors
minors.paragraph: The site is not intended for persons under [ÂGE — 13 in Belgium for consent to information society services] years of age and we do not knowingly collect their data. If you hold parental authority and become aware of such collection, contact us to have it removed.

changes.heading: 12. Changes to this policy
changes.paragraph: We may adapt this policy to reflect legal or technical developments. The applicable version is the one published on this page. In the event of a substantial change, we will inform you by [MOYEN — banner on the site / email to subscribers].

whatIsACookie.heading: 1. What is a cookie?
whatIsACookie.paragraph1: A cookie is a small text file placed on your device (computer, tablet, smartphone) when you visit a website. It allows the site to recognize your browser, remember certain information, or measure your browsing activity.
whatIsACookie.paragraph2: This policy also covers equivalent technologies: invisible pixels, web beacons, local storage (localStorage, sessionStorage), device identifiers and digital fingerprints. For simplicity, we refer to all of them as "cookies".

whoSets.heading: 2. Who sets these cookies?
whoSets.intro: The site [URL_DU_SITE] is published by [DÉNOMINATION_SOCIALE], [ADRESSE], company number [NUMÉRO_BCE].
whoSets.thirdParty: third-party cookies, set by providers we integrate into the site and who process data according to their own rules, which we link to in the table below.

consent.heading: 3. Your consent
consent.necessary: Cookies strictly necessary for the site to function are set without your consent: they are essential to provide you with the service you request.
consent.optional: All other cookies — audience measurement, comfort features, advertising, social media — are only set after your prior, free, specific and informed consent, collected via the banner shown on your first visit.
consent.noChoiceYet: Until you have made a choice, no non-essential cookie is set. Refusing is as easy as accepting, and refusing does not degrade your access to the site's content in any way.
consent.withdraw: Change or withdraw your choice at any time: [MOYEN_DE_RETRAIT — e.g. a "Manage my cookies" link in the footer / button below]. Withdrawal applies going forward and does not affect the lawfulness of prior consent-based processing.
consent.duration: Your choice is kept for [DURÉE — 6 months recommended, 13 months maximum], after which the banner reappears.

legalBasis.heading: 5. Legal basis and data processed
legalBasis.paragraph1: The setting and reading of non-essential cookies is based on your consent (article 6.1.a of the GDPR and article 129 of the Belgian law of 13 June 2005 on electronic communications). The setting of strictly necessary cookies is based on our legitimate interest in providing a functional and secure site.
legalBasis.paragraph2: The data processed via cookies (identifiers, IP address, pages viewed, browsing data) is described in more detail in our <link>Privacy Policy</link>, which also details your rights of access, rectification, erasure and objection.
legalBasis.transfersNote: Some of the providers listed above are established outside the European Economic Area. These transfers are governed by [MÉCANISME — adequacy decision / standard contractual clauses].

browserSettings.heading: 6. Managing cookies from your browser
browserSettings.intro: Independently of our banner, you can configure your browser to block or delete cookies. Warning: blocking all cookies, including strictly necessary ones, may degrade the site's functionality.
browserSettings.chrome: Chrome: Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies and other site data
browserSettings.firefox: Firefox: Settings → Privacy & Security → Cookies and Site Data
browserSettings.safari: Safari: Settings → Safari → Privacy and security
browserSettings.edge: Edge: Settings → Cookies and site permissions
browserSettings.deletionNote: Deleting cookies in your browser also erases the cookie that remembers your refusal: the banner will reappear on your next visit.

complaint.heading: 7. Complaint
complaint.paragraph: If you believe your rights are not being respected, you may lodge a complaint with the Belgian Data Protection Authority: Rue de la Presse 35, 1000 Brussels — +32 (0)2 274 48 00 — contact@apd-gba.be — www.autoriteprotectiondonnees.be

changes.heading: 8. Changes
changes.paragraph: This policy evolves along with the tools integrated into the site. The applicable version is the one published on this page.
